name: District of Commerce
desc: Section of [The City of the Drowned](location:the_city_of_the_drowned) that has a gate with a ramp outside of it to enter. In this district, you can also find a gate inside to the [Cathedral of the Interstice](location:cathedral_of_the_interstice), where you can ascend into your [Depths Trial](location:cathedral_of_the_interstice). This is the most popular district as it is more common to find players escaping the depths there due to the gate leading to [the Depths Trial](location:cathedral_of_the_interstice) and a structure near the surrounding wall that people can stack barrels upon it to border-walk located here. The District of Commerce does not have any watchers as well, which makes it less of a risk factor.
additional_info: -   The description of this area was previously "The corridors of trade have been hulled out and replaced with the endless procession of the lost."
